chunks.arabic_text: ٦٩٧ - وَأَمَّا مَسْجِدُ السَّهْلَةِ فَقَدْ قَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ

translations.en: 697 - As for Masjid al-Sahlah, al-Sadiq عليه السلام said:

chunks.arabic_text: «لَوِ اسْتَجَارَ عَمِّي زَيْدٌ بِهِ لَأَجَارَهُ اللَّهُ سَنَةً ذَلِكَ مَوْضِعُ بَيْتِ إِدْرِيسَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ الَّذِي كَانَ يَخِيطُ فِيهِ وَهُوَ الْمَوْضِعُ الَّذِي خَرَجَ مِنْهُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ إِلَى الْعَمَالِقَةِ وَهُوَ الْمَوْضِعُ الَّذِي خَرَجَ مِنْهُ دَاوُدُ إِلَى جَالُوتَ وَتَحْتَهُ صَخْرَةٌ خَضْرَاءُ فِيهَا صُورَةُ وَجْهِ كُلِّ نَبِيٍّ خَلَقَهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَمِنْ تَحْتِهِ أُخِذَتْ طِينَةُ كُلِّ نَبِيٍّ وَهُوَ مَوْضِعُ الرَّاكِبِ»

translations.en: "If my uncle Zayd had sought refuge in it, Allah would surely have granted him protection for a year. That is the place of the house of Idris عليه السلام, in which he used to sew, and it is the place from which Ibrahim عليه السلام went forth to the Amalekites. It is also the place from which Dawud went forth to Jalut, and beneath it is a green rock in which is the image of the face of every Prophet whom Allah, Mighty and Majestic, created; and from beneath it was taken the clay of every Prophet. And it is the place of the Rider."
So it was said to him: "And who is the Rider?"

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ «الْخَضِرُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ. وَأَمَّا مَسْجِدُ بَرَاثَا بِبَغْدَادَ فَصَلَّى فِيهِ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ لَمَّا رَجَعَ مِنْ قِتَالِ أَهْلِ النَّهْرَوَانِ.

translations.en: He said: "Al-Khiḍr عليه السلام. And as for Masjid Baratha in Baghdad, Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام prayed in it when he returned from fighting the people of al-Nahrawan."

en.summary: This hadith describes the special sanctity and sacred history of Masjid al-Sahlah, linking it to several Prophets عليهم السلام and presenting it as a place of refuge and blessing. It also mentions Masjid Baratha as a mosque in which Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام prayed after the battle of al-Nahrawan, highlighting the historical and spiritual distinction of certain mosques.
en.seo_question: What virtues and sacred history are mentioned for Masjid al-Sahlah and Masjid Baratha in Shia hadith?

key_terms.مَسْجِدُ السَّهْلَةِ: Masjid al-Sahlah, a mosque described here as possessing special sanctity and prophetic associations.
key_terms.اسْتَجَارَ: Sought refuge or protection in a sacred place.
key_terms.إِدْرِيسَ: Prophet Idris عليه السلام, whose house is said here to have been at this site.
key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمُ: Prophet Ibrahim عليه السلام, said to have departed from this place.
key_terms.دَاوُدُ: Prophet Dawud عليه السلام, said to have gone forth from this place to Jalut.
key_terms.صَخْرَةٌ خَضْرَاءُ: A green rock beneath the mosque, described as possessing sacred significance.
key_terms.طِينَةُ: The clay or primordial substance from which every Prophet is said here to have been taken.
key_terms.الْخَضِرُ: Al-Khiḍr عليه السلام, identified in the narration as 'the Rider.'
